reviews.title: “3-Day Free Trial” is Bogus
reviews.text:
This subscription app was supposed to have a 3-day free trial. Alas, they charged my account immediately. When I came back two days later to cancel, it was a done deal.

Caveat Emptor.

reviews.text: There’s a hard paywall during onboarding and somehow once you escape there are ads everywhere! Video ads and in app ads, Im shocked on how does such app get approved. The entire layout side scrolls for some reason. Please do better!

reviews.title: Paid for app
reviews.text: Super annoying feature even after paying $40/year.  Probably every third time you open the app it asks you if you like the app with an annoying pop and you have to click “yes or no”.   I’ve answered “no” about 5 times and it still keeps asking.  You guys have to fix this (especially for paid subscribers).  I’ve never had an app be this obnoxious for a review.
